goal: Add a `count` subcommand to the kv CLI (kvstore/cli.py) that prints the number of keys, honouring an optional --prefix like `keys` does. Add a unit test in tests/test_cli.py. Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -q` to confirm everything passes.

Store.page(page_size, page_number) in kvstore/store.py is documented as 1-based but is off by one: page 1 currently skips the first page_size keys. Fix it so page 1 returns the first page_size keys, page 2 the next page_size, and so on; a page past the end returns []. Add a regression test in tests/test_store.py and run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -q`.

Add a global `--json` flag to the kv CLI in kvstore/cli.py. With --json: `get` prints a JSON object {"key": ..., "value": ...} (and {"key": ..., "value": null} with exit code 1 when missing), `keys` prints a JSON array of the keys, `set` prints {"ok": true}, and `delete` prints {"deleted": true|false}. Without --json behaviour is unchanged. Add tests to tests/test_cli.py and run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -q`.

Add TTL support to kvstore. Store.set(key, value, ttl=None) accepts an optional ttl in seconds; an expired key is invisible to get/keys/page/delete (delete returns False) and expired entries must not come back after a Store is re-opened from the same path. Add `--ttl <seconds>` (float) to the CLI `set` subcommand. Add tests in tests/test_store.py (use a small ttl and time.sleep, or inject a clock) and run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -q`.

Refactor persistence in kvstore/store.py behind a backend abstraction: add kvstore/backends.py with a Backend base class exposing load() -> dict and save(data: dict), a MemoryBackend, and a JsonFileBackend(path). Store gains a `backend=` keyword; Store(path) must keep working exactly as before (it should construct a JsonFileBackend), and Store() with no arguments uses MemoryBackend. Export the backends from kvstore/__init__.py. Add tests in tests/test_backends.py and run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -q`.
